name: Spike
about: A time-boxed investigation that answers one question

labels: "type:spike"
---

## The question

<!-- One question, answerable by yes/no or by a number. "Which walking
     route provider do we use?" is a spike. "Look into routing" is not. -->

## Time box

<!-- Hours, decided before starting, and honoured. 4 h is usual, a day
     is a lot on a ten-day project. When the box is empty, you stop and
     report what you know — an unfinished spike is still an answer. -->

**Box:** _n hours_ · **Owner:** _name_

## What unblocks

<!-- The story or the decision waiting on this. A spike that blocks
     nothing is reading, not work. -->

## Output

<!-- A spike produces a written answer, not code. Two paragraphs in this
     issue, plus an ADR in docs/decisions/ if the answer settles
     something structural. Any code written is thrown away — that is the
     point. -->

- [ ] Answer written here
- [ ] ADR opened if the decision is structural
- [ ] Follow-up stories created, or the blocked story unblocked
